name: bounds_corrupt_object_envelope
reason: a quarantined object does not reach the model as the `unavailable` domain outcome. By tool_use_id, 5 of 5 came back as a protocol-level tool error (internal/mcp's expand and re_read render a store refusal through errResponse). By bare chunk hash, 5 of 5 came back as `miss` — that is, as ABSENT, which §12.3 forbids for a quarantined object because it tells a model the content was never there when in fact it was refused and preserved; internal/mcp/handlers_span.go maps the chunk-hash courtesy branch's failure straight to miss(). internal/mcp/unavailable_test.go already establishes the right answer for already_tried's equivalent backend failure. No path and no secret appears in any of these answers — they carry a 12-character hash prefix. Owner: internal/mcp.
detail: by tool_use_id: content_hash_mismatch=tool_error damaged_zstd_frame=tool_error decompression_bomb=tool_error physical_size_past_the_read_bound=tool_error truncated_object=tool_error; by bare chunk hash: content_hash_mismatch=miss damaged_zstd_frame=miss decompression_bomb=miss physical_size_past_the_read_bound=miss truncated_object=miss
